landing.title_before: Welcome! Are you ready to be
landing.subtitle: Distractions fade. Your goals don’t.

auth.backend_unreachable: Can't reach the backend - make sure it's running (uvicorn main:app --port 8000).
auth.signup_note: Just pick a username and password - no email needed, this connects straight to your own backend.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.avatar_hint: PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF - up to 5MB
profile.break_interval_hint: How often FocusGuard reminds you to take a break, in Focus Mode and everywhere else.

overview.subtitle: Here's how your last 7 days have looked. This dashboard reads real data from your tracker's backend.
overview.no_group_yet: No group yet - visit the Leaderboard page to create or join one.
overview.activity_summary: {{count}} active days in the last 6 months

focus.heading: Focus Mode
focus.subtitle: Commit to a block of time. Switch to anything distracting and the session breaks - no quiet way out.
focus.not_tracking: Not tracking right now - open the extension or start the system tracker to see it here.
focus.distraction_warning: On a distraction - session breaks in {{seconds}}s if you don't switch back.
focus.no_active_session: No active session. Pick a length and commit.
focus.on_break: On a break - come back when you're ready.
focus.break_penalty_msg: That early break cost you +{{minutes}} min.

streak.heading: Your streak
streak.subtitle: A day counts if your distracting switches stayed under your threshold. Consecutive days build your streak.
streak.no_badges: No badges yet - a 3-day streak earns your first one.
streak.no_tracked_days: No tracked days yet - run the tracker and come back here.

board.subtitle: Ranked by focus score: productive time divided by (productive + distracting) time, over the last 7 days.
board.no_group: You haven't joined a grove yet. Start one, or join a friend's with their code.
board.leave_group_confirm: Leave "{{name}}"? You can join or create another group right after.

insight.heading: Weekly insight
insight.subtitle: A short AI-written summary of your last 7 days, plus the raw numbers behind it.

history.heading: History
history.subtitle: Every tracked app and tab, browser and system alike, broken down by day and by where your time actually went.
history.no_distraction_data: No distractions tracked yet - keep it up!

badges.heading: Badges
badges.subtitle: Every badge marks a focus habit you've built. Keep going to unlock them all.

first_spark.name: First Spark
first_spark.desc: Complete your first Focus Mode session.

deep_diver.name: Deep Diver
deep_diver.desc: Complete a focus session of 50 minutes or more.

iron_will.name: Iron Will
iron_will.desc: Finish a focus session without touching a distraction.

zen_master.name: Zen Master
zen_master.desc: Spend a day with 1+ hour of productive time and zero distracting switches.

night_owl.name: Night Owl
night_owl.desc: Get productive work done after 10 PM.

squad_up.name: Squad Up
squad_up.desc: Join or create a study group.

top_of_pack.name: Top of the Pack
top_of_pack.desc: Rank #1 in your group this week.

tracker.online: Desktop tracker connected - your apps are being tracked
tracker.title: Your desktop apps aren't being tracked
tracker.body: A website can't see apps like Word, File Explorer or VS Code. FocusGuard's small desktop tracker can - run it once and it tracks them for you.
tracker.step_download: Download the tracker and open it.
tracker.step_sign_in: Sign in with this same account.
tracker.step_startup: Choose "Start with Windows" - it then runs quietly in the background every day.
tracker.windows_only: Windows 10/11. Already installed? It starts with Windows - or open it again.
tracker.local_body: The desktop tracker isn't running. It starts by itself when you sign in here; if it doesn't, start FocusGuard with python launch_focusguard.py.
